description: Ross and Rachel finally become a couple while Joey's acting career rises, Monica begins a serious relationship with Richard and the friends' growing independence repeatedly collides with money, work and family.

s02e01.description: Rachel prepares to tell Ross how she feels, only to meet his new girlfriend Julie when he returns from China.

s02e02.description: Rachel resents Monica's growing friendship with Julie, while Ross struggles with his discomfort around Carol breastfeeding Ben.

s02e03.description: Mr. Heckles dies and leaves his belongings to Monica and Rachel, prompting Chandler to fear he may end up alone and obsessive.

s02e04.description: Phoebe's secret husband unexpectedly appears, while Rachel tries to keep Ross and Julie from becoming more serious.

s02e05.description: Money differences split the friends when expensive plans leave Joey, Rachel and Phoebe feeling excluded from the wealthier half of the group.

s02e06.description: Chandler and Joey lose Ben on a bus while babysitting, as Phoebe loses her Central Perk singing spot to a professional performer.

s02e07.description: Rachel drunkenly confesses her feelings for Ross, forcing him to confront what he wants while Monica tries to whip Chandler into shape.

s02e08.description: Ross makes a disastrous pros-and-cons list comparing Rachel and Julie, while Monica invents recipes for a questionable new food product.

s02e09.description: Phoebe searches for the father she never knew while Monica's overheated holiday party becomes increasingly chaotic.

s02e10.description: Rachel dates Russ, a man disturbingly similar to Ross, while Joey faces an indecent proposition from a casting director.

s02e11.description: Carol and Susan prepare to marry while Rachel's mother questions her own marriage and Phoebe becomes convinced she is channeling an elderly client.

s02e12-13.description: Ross searches for Marcel on a movie set, Joey meets an dangerously devoted fan and Phoebe reluctantly performs children's songs. The Marcel search continues as Monica and Rachel pursue Jean-Claude Van Damme and Chandler becomes involved with a makeup artist.

s02e14.description: An old prom video reveals how deeply Ross once cared for Rachel, changing her view of him just when their relationship seemed finished.

s02e15.description: Ross and Rachel finally become a couple, while Monica begins seeing Richard and Joey and Chandler become obsessed with their new television.

s02e16.description: Joey's success allows him to move into his own apartment, while Rachel gets a tattoo and Monica's romance with Richard becomes public.

s02e17.description: Chandler's eccentric new roommate Eddie moves in, while Joey adjusts badly to living alone and Phoebe attempts to make a music video.

s02e18.description: Joey's boastful interview gets his soap character killed off, while Eddie's behavior convinces Chandler that his new roommate is genuinely unstable.

s02e19.description: Chandler tries increasingly desperate ways to make Eddie leave, while Joey faces unemployment and the women embrace an empowering self-help book.

s02e20.description: Phoebe discovers that Old Yeller does not end happily, while Ross's talk of a future with Rachel makes her panic.

s02e21.description: Ross and Chandler are driven out of Central Perk by bullies, while Monica gambles in the stock market and Phoebe again searches for her father.

s02e22.description: Rachel's divorcing parents both arrive for her birthday, forcing the friends to run two simultaneous parties and keep them apart.

s02e23.description: Phoebe and her visiting submariner boyfriend get chicken pox together, while Joey impersonates a data processor at Chandler's office.

s02e24.description: Rachel serves as maid of honor at Barry and Mindy's wedding, while Monica and Richard confront whether they want the same future.
